verdict.rationale: Headless or CI use is a fair question for an authenticator product, since some authenticators expose CLIs for generating codes in automation. The evidence describes only an interactive mobile app: tap-to-approve, biometric or PIN App Lock, and QR scanning. No headless mode, CLI, or API is documented, and the probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
